text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Marking the end of the year, the WBC is 
finally held. Having proven their 
strength, <chrname> steps up for the concluding 
race of their Classic year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the Three Goddesses watching over 
them, they stepped onto the grand stage to 
showcase the fruits of everything they had 
built together...!
